INVESTIGATIONS OF MULTIPLE MYELOMA
Investigations
Diagnosis is based on the presence of at least 10% clonal bone marrow plasma
cells and monoclonal protein in serum or urine
In patients with true non-secretory myeloma, the diagnosis is based on 30%
monoclonal bone marrow plasma cells or a biopsy proven plasmacytoma
